description: Abstract class for validation in Zend Framework, providing message handling, translation, and configuration for validators.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Abstract
classes.description: An abstract base class for validators in Zend Framework, handling message templates, translation, and validation logic.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns array of validation failure messages.

methods.name: getMessageVariables
methods.description: Returns array of message variable names used in failure messages.

methods.name: getMessageTemplates
methods.description: Returns the message templates used by the validator.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a specific message template for a given key.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets multiple message templates at once.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access 'value' or message variables.

methods.name: _createMessage
methods.description: Constructs a validation failure message, applying translation and formatting.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Adds an error message with a specific key and value.

methods.name: _setValue
methods.description: Sets the value to be validated and clears messages and errors.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns array of validation failure message codes (deprecated).

methods.name: setObscureValue
methods.description: Sets whether the value should be obfuscated in messages.

methods.name: getObscureValue
methods.description: Gets whether the value is obfuscated in messages.

methods.name: setTranslator
methods.description: Sets the translation object for the validator.

methods.name: getTranslator
methods.description: Returns the current translation object.

methods.name: hasTranslator
methods.description: Checks if the validator has its own translator.

methods.name: setDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Sets the default translation object for all validators.

methods.name: getDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Gets the default translation object.

methods.name: hasDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Checks if a default translator is set.

methods.name: setDisableTranslator
methods.description: Disables or enables translation.

methods.name: translatorIsDisabled
methods.description: Checks if translation is disabled.

methods.name: getMessageLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum message length.

methods.name: setMessageLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum message length.
